question: When did the All India Congress formalise the demand for 'Purna Swaraj' or full independence for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**At its Lahore Session in 1929.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The All India Congress formalized the demand for 'Purna Swaraj' or full independence for India at its Lahore Session in 1929.**

 
 
• This demand was made on January 26, 1930, which was celebrated as Independence Day or 'Purna Swaraj Day'.
 
• The Lahore Session was presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, who delivered the famous 'Tryst with Destiny' speech on the eve of India's independence in 1947.
 
• The Lahore Session also adopted the 'Poorna Swaraj Resolution' which declared that the goal of the Congress was complete independence for India.
 
 
 
• The Karachi Session of the All India Congress was held in 1931, but it did not formalize the demand for 'Purna Swaraj'.
 
• The Guwahati Session of the All India Congress was held in 1926, but it did not formalize the demand for 'Purna Swaraj'.
 
• The Madras Session of the All India Congress was held in 1927, but it did not formalize the demand for 'Purna Swaraj'..
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Indian National Congress (INC) was formed by Allan Octavian Hume in 1885.
 
• The first session of INC was held in Bombay from 28–31 December 1885 under the chairmanship of W.C. Bannerjee.
